text:
The air shines, shines,

midday shines,

but I do not see the sun.


And from presence to presence

everything turns transparent to me,

but I do not see the sun.


Lost among transparencies,

I go from reflection to radiance,

but I do not see the sun.


And it strips itself bare in the light

and questions every splendor,

but does not see the sun.

translation.title: The Air Shines, Shines…
translation.editorial_note: Reuses a reviewed translation of the identical source body.
